checks.name: skip link receives visible keyboard focus and moves Enter focus to main
Main navigation: all controls reachable by Tab, with Home/End and four arrows
navigation End and Enter open Settings with an announced current page
Nine modes and three replay controls: all controls reachable by Tab, with Home/End and four arrows
Space opens a mode and keeps the Play navigation state
Player side controls: all controls reachable by Tab, with Home/End and four arrows
changing the player side keeps focus on its regenerated pressed button
Fighter cards: all controls reachable by Tab, with Home/End and four arrows

scope: Desktop and 390 px Chromium. Real Tab, Enter, Space, arrow and Home/End events; one virtual standard gamepad through navigator.getGamepads only.
limits: No screen-reader, switch-control or voice-control session.
This covers the named menu and dialog journeys, not every OS/browser accessibility combination.
